entities.summary: Didier Berthet was a French Roman Catholic prelate who was bishop of Saint-Dié from June 2016 until his death. Raised as a Protestant, Berthet converted to the Catholic Church as a young adult after attending an event when Pope John Paul II was present in France in 1980. He was ordained a priest of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Nanterre in 1992 and in 2016 was named bishop of Saint-Dié.
